name: @kiwa-test/api
description: HTTP API test adapter for kiwa (Vitest + msw + supertest)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/msw-bridge.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/request-client.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/setup-api-server.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
